title: Quadricapsular
summary: QUADRICAP'SULAR, adjective [Latin quadra and capsula.] In botany, having four capsules to a flower; as a quadricapsular pericarp.

inlines.v: QUADRICAP'SULAR, adjective [Latin quadra and capsula.] In botany, having four capsules to a flower; as a quadricapsular pericarp.
